sources.title: GitHub Enterprise 现已可直接使用 GitHub Copilot / GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot
sources.title_zh: GitHub Enterprise 现已可直接使用 GitHub Copilot
sources.title_en: GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot
sources.title_original: GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Enterprise 现将 Copilot 纳入每位授权用户，此前需分别管理 Copilot 席位与 AI 用量，现从首次请求起按企业预算计量；未持许可证者可用 Copilot Standalone，每人每月 10 美元，两种方式均不含每月 AI credits。

en.reason: GitHub Enterprise now bundles Copilot for every licensed user, replacing separate seat and AI-usage management with usage metered against the enterprise budget from the first request, while non-licensed users can get Copilot Standalone at $10 per user monthly, excluding monthly AI credits.

stories.title: Ed Zitron 长文解析 Anthropic S-1：称其把散户当作退出流动性 / Exit Liquidity
stories.source: Ed Zitron 长文 / Where’s Your Ed At（RSS）

sources.title: Ed Zitron 长文解析 Anthropic S-1：称其把散户当作退出流动性 / Exit Liquidity
sources.title_zh: Ed Zitron 长文解析 Anthropic S-1：称其把散户当作退出流动性
sources.title_en: Exit Liquidity
sources.title_original: Exit Liquidity
sources.summary: Ed Zitron 撰文批评 Anthropic 的 S-1 招股书，指其仅披露 Q2 盈利数据、省略 Q3 现金状况和付款明细，是在公司基本面变化前误导投资者。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借 Apollo 首席经济学家 Torsten Slok 的图表指出，自 ChatGPT 2022年11月发布以来，S&P 500 利润率反而恶化，AI 也未提升 ROIC，并批评泡沫叙事回避可衡量指标。
sources.source: Ed Zitron 长文 / Where’s Your Ed At（RSS）

en.summary: Ed Zitron criticized Anthropic's S-1 prospectus, arguing that it discloses only Q2 profitability data while omitting Q3 cash position and payment details, misleading investors ahead of a change in the company's fundamentals.
en.reason: Ed Zitron argues Anthropic’s S-1 discloses only Q2 profit while omitting Q3 cash and payment details, and, citing Torsten Slok, notes S&P 500 margins have worsened since ChatGPT’s November 2022 launch without AI lifting ROIC.

stories.title: Alphabet Q3 财报：年化收入达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 增长 103% / Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.

sources.title: Alphabet Q3 财报：年化收入达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 增长 103% / Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
sources.title_zh: Alphabet Q3 财报：年化收入达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 增长 103%
sources.title_en: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
sources.title_original: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
sources.summary: Sundar Pichai 发布 Alphabet Q3 业绩：年化收入 run rate 达 5000 亿美元，总收入同比增长 25%。Google Cloud 收入增长 103%，1P 模型 API 每分钟处理近 32B tokens（环比增 40%）；Search 查询同比增速为五年来最高，并提到 Argon、Carbon 领跑前沿及最新世界模型 Genie 4。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet Q3财报显示年化营收规模达half-trillion美元、营收同比增长25%，AI投入推动Search整体及商业查询增长，同比查询增速为近五年最高。

en.summary: Sundar Pichai reports Alphabet Q3 results: annualized revenue run rate reaches $500 billion, total revenue up 25% year over year. stories.title: Anthropic S-1 显示 90% 增量毛利，SemiAnalysis 播客详解其中数字

sources.title: Anthropic S-1 显示 90% 增量毛利，SemiAnalysis 播客详解其中数字
sources.title_zh: Anthropic S-1 显示 90% 增量毛利，SemiAnalysis 播客详解其中数字
sources.title_original: Anthropic S-1 显示 90% 增量毛利，SemiAnalysis 播客详解其中数字
sources.summary: Saito 转述 SemiAnalysis 播客对 Anthropic S-1 的解读：招股书口径为增量毛利 90%、推理毛利 85%、连续两个季度盈利，Q1 净收入留存达 500%，收入同比涨 1368% 而算力费用只涨 300%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic 的 S-1 自报增量毛利 90%、增量 EBIT 40%，SemiAnalysis 播客据此拆解推理毛利 85%、客户一年花 1 美元变 9 美元等数字，讨论这门生意是否真的成立。

en.title: Anthropic's S-1 shows 90% incremental gross margin; SemiAnalysis podcast breaks down the numbers
en.summary: Saito relays SemiAnalysis podcast’s read of Anthropic’s S-1: prospectus figures show 90% incremental gross margin, 85% inference gross margin, two consecutive profitable quarters, Q1 net revenue retention of 500%, and revenue up 1,368% YoY while compute costs rose only 300%.
en.reason: Anthropic's S-1 reports 90% incremental gross margin and 40% incremental EBIT, while SemiAnalysis's podcast unpacks 85% inference margin, 500% Q1 net revenue retention, 1,368% revenue growth against 300% compute-cost growth and whether the business holds up.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO 最大赢家或为 Amazon 而非 VC / VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more

sources.title: Anthropic IPO 最大赢家或为 Amazon 而非 VC / VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
sources.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 最大赢家或为 Amazon 而非 VC
sources.title_en: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
sources.title_original: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
sources.summary: TechCrunch 根据 Anthropic 的 S-1 分析，VC 持股均不足 5%，而 Amazon 可能是 IPO 最大财务受益方。Amazon 持有 62 亿美元本金可转债、其自估持仓价值 979 亿美元，另投 100 亿美元无投票权优先股，累计投资约 180 亿美元；Anthropic 还承诺未来 10 年在 AWS 至少消费 1100 亿美元。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章通过 massive note conversions 揭示 Amazon 在 Anthropic 的实际持股规模，并指出 VCs 虽将在 Anthropic IPO 中获利数十亿美元，Amazon 的收益却会多得多。

en.summary: TechCrunch, analyzing Anthropic's S-1, found that no VC holds more than 5%, while Amazon may be the biggest financial beneficiary of the IPO. Amazon holds $6.2 billion in principal convertible notes, values its stake at $97.9 billion, and has separately invested $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock, for cumulative investment of about $18 billion; Anthropic has also committed to spending at least $110 billion on AWS over the next 10 years.
en.reason: Amazon’s $18 billion Anthropic investment—including $6.2 billion in convertible notes it values at $97.9 billion and $10 billion in non-voting preferred stock—makes it the IPO’s biggest beneficiary, with Anthropic committed to at least $110 billion in AWS spending.

sources.title: 犹他州 10 个州政府部门 34 名开发者试点使用 Claude Code / Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
sources.title_zh: 犹他州 10 个州政府部门 34 名开发者试点使用 Claude Code
sources.title_en: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
sources.title_original: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
sources.summary: Boris Cherny 介绍犹他州向 10 个州政府部门的 34 名开发者提供了 Claude Code。试点显示 80% 的开发者在 30 分钟内搭好可用环境，71% 的开发者在为期四周的试点结束前报告节省了 20 小时以上时间。该推文引用了 Anthropic 与 GSA 合作将 Claude 以 40% 折扣提供给联邦及各级政府的公告作为背景。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Utah 在 10 个州政府机构的 34 名开发者中试点 Claude Code，为期四周，80% 的人 30 分钟内就搭建好工作环境，71% 反馈节省了 20 多个小时。

en.summary: Boris Cherny says Utah provided Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state government departments. The pilot showed 80% of developers had a working environment set up within 30 minutes, and 71% reported saving more than 20 hours before the four-week pilot ended. The tweet cites as background Anthropic's announcement with GSA that Claude would be offered to federal and all levels of government at a 40% discount.
en.reason: Utah’s four-week Claude Code pilot with 34 developers across 10 state agencies found 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes and 71% reported saving more than 20 hours.

sources.summary: Microsoft 宣布将 GitHub 团队打造的 Copilot harness 通过 Microsoft Foundry 向开发者和企业开放，该 harness 已驱动 Copilot Code、Copilot Studio、GitHub Copilot app 和 CLI 等产品。

en.summary: Microsoft announced that the Copilot harness built by the GitHub team is now available to developers and enterprises through Microsoft Foundry; the harness already powers products including Copilot Code, Copilot Studio, the GitHub Copilot app and CLI.
en.reason: Microsoft is opening the GitHub-built Copilot harness through Microsoft Foundry so enterprises can run agents that reason, use tools and handle long tasks across 20+ frontier models with BYOK, now ported to Rust to cut session overhead and time-to-first token.

stories.title: Axiom 智能体集群用 24 天完成有限单群分类定理的机器验证 / Verified AI just had its greatest month.

sources.title: Axiom 智能体集群用 24 天完成有限单群分类定理的机器验证 / Verified AI just had its greatest month.
sources.title_zh: Axiom 智能体集群用 24 天完成有限单群分类定理的机器验证
sources.title_en: Verified AI just had its greatest month.
sources.title_original: Verified AI just had its greatest month.
sources.summary: 作者称 Verified AI 迎来标志性月份，Axiom 的 AI 智能体集群用 24 天完成数学史上最长证明的验证，将跨越 500 多篇论文的 15,000 页有限单群分类定理（CFSG）转化为 3800 万行以上机器验证代码，并发现已发表记录中的 34 处严重出入。引用内容补充称该形式化证明可能是最大的开源项目之一，图中显示 Axiom CFSG 达 43.0M 行，约每 37 天翻倍。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 一群 AI agents 核查了史上最长数学证明的每一步，数学家已依赖 Classification of Finite Simple Groups 40多年却无人能独自验完，文章记录 Verified AI 迄今最亮眼的一个月。

en.summary: The author says Verified AI had a landmark month: Axiom's swarm of AI agents verified the longest proof in mathematical history in 24 days, converting the 15,000-page Classification of Finite Simple Groups (CFSG)—spanning more than 500 papers—into over 38 million lines of machine-verified code and finding 34 serious discrepancies in the published record. The quoted material adds that the formal proof may be one of the largest open-source projects; a chart shows Axiom CFSG at 43.0M lines, doubling roughly every 37 days.
en.reason: An Axiom AI agent swarm verified the 15,000-page, 500-plus-paper Classification of Finite Simple Groups in 24 days, turning it into over 38 million lines of machine-checked code and flagging 34 serious discrepancies in the published record.

stories.title: a16z 调研 100 位 CISO：AI 如何改写 2027 年安全议程 / The New Security Agenda

sources.title: a16z 调研 100 位 CISO：AI 如何改写 2027 年安全议程 / The New Security Agenda
sources.title_zh: a16z 调研 100 位 CISO：AI 如何改写 2027 年安全议程
sources.title_en: The New Security Agenda
sources.title_original: The New Security Agenda
sources.summary: a16z 发布对 100 名千人员以上企业 CISO 的调研，87% 预期 2027 年安全支出增长，主要受 AI 威胁和自身 AI 部署扩大攻击面驱动。2027 年最受关注的七项安全举措全部与 AI 相关，其中 SOC 自动化获最多首选票，内部 AI agent 安全、SOC 自动化和进攻性安全升幅最大，但 AI SOC 工具生产环境使用率仅 18%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章调查100名CISO发现，87%预计2027年安全支出因AI威胁上升，近半计划扩编团队、仅4%预计裁员。

en.summary: a16z surveyed 100 CISOs at companies with more than 1,000 employees: 87% expect security spending to rise by 2027, driven mainly by AI threats and the expanded attack surface from their own AI deployments. All seven of the most-watched security initiatives for 2027 are AI-related, with SOC automation receiving the most first-choice votes; internal AI agent security, SOC automation and offensive security saw the biggest gains, yet only 18% of AI SOC tools are in production use.
en.reason: a16z’s survey of 100 CISOs at 1,000-plus-employee enterprises finds 87% expect 2027 security spending to rise on AI threats and AI-expanded attack surfaces, with SOC automation the top priority yet only 18% using AI SOC tools in production.

en.title: Google releases world model Genie 4 with real-time control and native audio
en.summary: Google has released Genie 4, its next-generation world model, with clear gains over Genie 3 in photorealistic detail and physics simulation such as object collisions. Users can control characters or the camera in real time with WASD and dual joysticks, change the weather and add objects mid-session using natural language, and the model also generates synchronized ambient sound and real-time character dialogue.
en.reason: Google's Genie 4 world model improves on Genie 3 with photorealistic visuals and physics simulation like object collisions, letting users steer characters or cameras via WASD and dual sticks, change weather or add objects by natural language, and generate synchronized ambient audio and live character dialogue.

sources.summary:
Google is opening up Android Studio to third-party AI agents. Through a new "Bring Your Own Agent" feature, the IDE now supports more than 40 coding agents, including Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex. Google says new terminal tools also help agents finish UI tasks 77 percent faster while using up to three times fewer tokens. Android development is becoming agent-centric too.

stories.title: Nvidia 开源的 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 集转录、翻译与说话人识别于一身 / Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition

sources.title: Nvidia 开源的 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 集转录、翻译与说话人识别于一身 / Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 开源的 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 集转录、翻译与说话人识别于一身
sources.title_en: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
sources.title_original: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
sources.summary:
Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech recognition model that handles transcription, speaker recognition, and translation and takes its instructions as text prompts. It leads several benchmarks and uses only a sixth of the active parameters of its strongest open rival. Nvidia is also shipping a dataset with more than 800,000 hours of speech, along with tools for fine-tuning.
Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech recognition model that handles transcript
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Nvidia 发布开源语音模型 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，单个模型即可完成转写、说话人识别与翻译，支持40种语言转写、31种语言与英语互译、识别13种语言中的说话人，并可处理长达一小时、最多八人的录音，在 Hugging Face 英语开放 ASR 排行榜以5.33%平均词错误率位列开放权重模型第一，同时附带超80万小时语音数据集与微调工具。

en.reason: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe handles 40-language transcription, translation between 31 languages and English, and 13-language speaker recognition, topping Hugging Face's English open ASR leaderboard at 5.33% average word error rate while shipping an 800,000-hour speech dataset and fine-tuning tools.

【中国AI模型出海，监管边界逐渐明朗】

据 Bill Bishop 转发的路透社10月28日报道，中国AI企业正询问：若在外国公司拥有的海外服务器训练或运行先进模型，是否触及技术出口规则。

商务部10月16日公布的目录修订仍在征求意见，拟将大模型、智能体等23项AI技术纳入管理，并已对列明技术出口实行临时登记。官方明确：API、App、SaaS方式向境外提供调用，不属于大模型技术出口；限制类模型在海外本地部署属管理范围，海外自有云可适用自动许可。外国持有服务器的情形仍待厘清。

路透社报道：https://t.co/tZkSnX…

en.title:
Chinese AI Models Go Global as Regulatory Boundaries Come Into Focus

Chinese AI companies are asking whether training or running advanced models on overseas servers owned by foreign companies would trigger technology export rules, according to an October 28 Reuters report shared by Bill Bishop.
en.summary:
[Chinese AI models go global as regulatory boundaries come into focus]

According to an October 28 Reuters report shared by Bill Bishop, Chinese AI companies are asking whether training or running advanced models on overseas servers owned by foreign companies would trigger technology export rules.

The catalog revision published by the Ministry of Commerce on October 16 is still open for comment. It proposes bringing 23 AI technologies, including large models and agents, under regulation, and has already introduced temporary registration for exports of listed technologies. Officials have made clear that providing overseas access via API, App, or SaaS does not count as exporting large-model technology; local deployment of restricted models overseas falls within the scope of regulation, while overseas self-owned cloud can use automatic licensing. The situation for foreign-owned servers still needs to be clarified.

Ministry of Commerce explanation: https://t.co/hK54KzzFGP
Reuters report: https://t.co/tZkSnX…
en.reason: China's Commerce Ministry is consulting on a catalogue revision published October 16 that would add 23 AI technologies, including large models and agents, to export controls with temporary registration already in force, while clarifying that API, App and SaaS calls from abroad do not count as technology exports but leaving the status of foreign-owned overseas servers unresolved.

【中国AI模型出海，监管边界逐渐明朗】

据 Bill Bishop 转发的路透社10月28日报道，中国AI企业正询问：若在外国公司拥有的海外服务器训练或运行先进模型，是否触及技术出口规则。

商务部10月16日公布的目录修订仍在征求意见，拟将大模型、智能体等23项AI技术纳入管理，并已对列明技术出口实行临时登记。官方明确：API、App、SaaS方式向境外提供调用，不属于大模型技术出口；限制类模型在海外本地部署属管理范围，海外自有云可适用自动许可。外国持有服务器的情形仍待厘清。

en.title:
Chinese AI Models Go Global as Regulatory Boundaries Come Into Focus

Chinese AI companies are asking whether training or running advanced models on overseas servers owned by foreign companies would trigger technology export rules, according to an October 28 Reuters report shared by Bill Bishop.
en.summary:
[Chinese AI models go global as regulatory boundaries come into focus]

According to an October 28 Reuters report shared by Bill Bishop, Chinese AI companies are asking whether training or running advanced models on overseas servers owned by foreign companies would trigger technology export rules.

The catalog revision published by the Ministry of Commerce on October 16 is still open for comment. It proposes bringing 23 AI technologies, including large models and agents, under regulation, and has already introduced temporary registration for exports of listed technologies. Officials have made clear that providing overseas access via API, App, or SaaS does not count as exporting large-model technology; local deployment of restricted models overseas falls within the scope of regulation, while overseas self-owned cloud can use automatic licensing. The situation for foreign-owned servers still needs to be clarified.

Ministry of Commerce explanation: https://t.co/hK54KzzFGP
Reuters report: https://t.co/tZkSnX…
en.reason: China's Commerce Ministry is consulting on a catalogue revision published October 16 that would add 23 AI technologies, including large models and agents, to export controls with temporary registration already in force, while clarifying that API, App and SaaS calls from abroad do not count as technology exports but leaving the status of foreign-owned overseas servers unresolved.

en.title: Stop just writing prompts — start actually hiring Agents: enterprise Agent management in practice | Tech Practice
en.summary:
The organizations pulling ahead aren’t winning because they have better models or bigger budgets. They’re winning because they’ve stopped treating agents as tools that need carefully engineered prompts and started treating them as “employees” who need to be assigned to specific roles.

Word count: 2,339. Reading time: about 8 minutes.

The core bottleneck to putting agents to work in the enterprise isn’t technology — it’s the absence of organizational governance. Leading companies treat agents as “digital employees” whose job responsibilities, skill requirements, and lines of accountability must be defined.

Job descriptions matter more than prompts; agents need clear organizational roles and oversight mechanisms; managers need dedicated training to take on governance responsibilities.

Intended for AI platform engineers, data and AI leaders, and enterprise architects.

What substantive breakthroughs will agents make in enterprise applications in 2026? Download the “2026 AI and Data Development Predictions” whitepaper for first-hand expert forecasts and a head start on the new way of working.

en.reason: A global automaker screened agents with 170 questions across five rounds, demanding they outperform humans rather than merely approach them, highlighting why enterprise agent adoption hinges on governance and job descriptions more than prompt engineering.

en.summary:
The organizations pulling ahead aren’t winning because they have better models or bigger budgets. They’re winning because they’ve stopped treating agents as tools that need carefully engineered prompts and started treating them as “employees” who need to be assigned to specific roles.

Word count: 2,339. Reading time: about 8 minutes.

The core bottleneck to putting agents to work in the enterprise isn’t technology — it’s the absence of organizational governance. Leading companies treat agents as “digital employees” whose job responsibilities, skill requirements, and lines of accountability must be defined.

Job descriptions matter more than prompts; agents need clear organizational roles and oversight mechanisms; managers need dedicated training to take on governance responsibilities.

Intended for AI platform engineers, data and AI leaders, and enterprise architects.

What substantive breakthroughs will agents make in enterprise applications in 2026? Download the “2026 AI and Data Development Predictions” whitepaper for first-hand expert forecasts and a head start on the new way of working.

en.reason: A global automaker screened agents with 170 questions across five rounds, demanding they outperform humans rather than merely approach them, highlighting why enterprise agent adoption hinges on governance and job descriptions more than prompt engineering.

A multi-agent workflow from Lauren Tan, a senior engineer at SpaceXAI who previously worked at Cursor, is going viral online:

1 AI chief of staff handles planning.

3 AI project managers break down tasks.

40+ AI employees write code, test, and ship.

Humans only need to set goals and review results, and the AI team keeps pushing the project forward.

Before, one person did one person's work; now one person can command an AI army!

en.title: Long read: why is today's local AI just a toy for enthusiasts?
en.summary:
A long read: why is local AI just a toy for enthusiasts right now?

Online discussion about running AI locally has been consistently heated, with many people showing off how they got some open-source model running on their own computer. But veteran AI tech blogger Matthew Berman argues that for the vast majority of people, running AI locally has almost no practical value at this stage.

Many people conflate local AI with open-source AI. Open-source models can be hosted in the cloud, with compute provided by various cloud service providers, whereas true local AI means running entirely offline on your own physical device. That sounds cool—it guarantees absolute data privacy and means you don't have to worry about getting banned—but the actual cost and the experience you get are completely out of proportion.

en.title: Long read: why is today's local AI just a toy for enthusiasts?
en.summary:
A long read: why is local AI just a toy for enthusiasts right now?

Online discussion about running AI locally has been consistently heated, with many people showing off how they got some open-source model running on their own computer. But veteran AI tech blogger Matthew Berman argues that for the vast majority of people, running AI locally has almost no practical value at this stage.

Many people conflate local AI with open-source AI. Open-source models can be hosted in the cloud, with compute provided by various cloud service providers, whereas true local AI means running entirely offline on your own physical device. That sounds cool—it guarantees absolute data privacy and means you don't have to worry about getting banned—but the actual cost and the experience you get are completely out of proportion.

stories.title: 最近 Anthropic 平台负责人 Katelyn Lesse 的一条长文火了，名字叫《软件工程师需要解决的新一系列问题》，读完很有感触，跟大家分享下。 里面提到，现在许多程序员正在经历一场堪称身份危机的考验，因为工作已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。 有人感到沮丧，有人感觉正在迎来人生中最尽兴的时刻。 她的感受是，在未来几年软件工程师需要出手解决一系列问题，才能让 AI 真正发挥潜力，现在就是成为一名软件工程师的绝佳时代。 多智能体系统正…

stories.title: Claude Code 撑起史上最大 IPO，被封号不退费的中国开发者撑起那 5%“脏收入”

sources.title: Claude Code 撑起史上最大 IPO，被封号不退费的中国开发者撑起那 5%“脏收入”
sources.title_zh: Claude Code 撑起史上最大 IPO，被封号不退费的中国开发者撑起那 5%“脏收入”
sources.title_original: Claude Code 撑起史上最大 IPO，被封号不退费的中国开发者撑起那 5%“脏收入”
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic 的 S-1 称 Claude Code 是增长核心，却披露 5% 到 7% 收入来自违规客户，按 331 亿美元营收折算为 17 亿至 23 亿美元，并追问被封号不退费的中国开发者年费占多少。

en.title: Claude Code powers the biggest IPO in history, while banned Chinese developers who never got refunds account for that 5% of "dirty revenue
en.reason: Anthropic's S-1 makes Claude Code its central growth engine, with enterprise clients spending 20 times more than regular users and over 90% of its codebase written by the tool, yet admits 5%–7% of revenue—roughly $1.7–2.3 billion of $33.1 billion—comes from rule-breaking customers, raising the question of how much is banned Chinese developers' non-refundable annual fees.

en.title: Anthropic yesterday announced early progress on using Claude for drug development: six partners plus an in-house project.
en.summary:
Anthropic yesterday shared early progress on using Claude for drug discovery: six partners plus an in-house project. The most interesting parts aren't the "roughly 35,000 antibody designs generated," but these:

· BigHat: Claude and researchers suspected that commonly used thermostability/aggregation metrics were misleading, went back and reanalyzed the raw data, and proposed new metrics. Wet-lab experiments confirmed most of the main predictions; the best variant showed more than a 10x improvement in binding affinity.
· Enveda: Across 1,061 pages of production documentation, it caught all 11 issues found manually and identified 7 more, cutting review time by 89%.
· Generate: A segment of CAR-T design was shortened by about 70%, with receptor expression up about 10x.

The company also noted that most of this is still preclinical.

Takeaway: The value of scientific research agents lies in rechecking against real data, …
en.reason: Anthropic reported early Claude-powered drug-discovery work with six partners and internal projects, including BigHat’s best variant improving binding over 10-fold and Enveda cutting review time 89% across 1,061 pages while finding 11 known plus 7 extra issues.

en.title: AI-Native Organization Implementation Handbook: Illustrated Edition

en.title: After hundreds of rounds of daily conversations with AI, I started looking into how to worry less
en.summary: The author shares lessons from long-term human-AI collaboration, building workflows with the Cohub visual workbench and the Mirasim multi-person + AI collaborative space. The piece also explores often-overlooked pain points such as asynchronous collaboration between people and AI, permission maintenance, and trust building. This human-centered, symbiotic approach is well worth a look for anyone using AI intensively for creative development.

sources.summary:
扩散智能开源 Clover，重构底层网络架构
扩散智能开源 Clover，重构底层网络架构
本文字数：3415 字
阅读完需：约 11 分钟
扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代去噪与并行 Token 更新突破自回归串行限制，Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 首次将 MoE 架构引入大规模 dLLM，总参 35B、激活参 3B。
dLLM 解耦生成顺序，支持更高并行度；Clover-35B 采用 MoE 实现参数规模与推理效率平衡；开源预览版为验证大模型尺度下 dLLM 能力边界提供首个实证基线。
适合 NLP 算法工程师、大模型推理优化工程师、AI 架构师阅读。
大语言模型一定要从左到右、逐个生成 Token 吗？
过去几年，以 GPT、Claude、Qwen 为代表的自回归语言模型一直占据主流。随着模型能力不断提升，逐 Token 解码带来的串行计算开销，也成为影响推理速度的重要因素之一。
扩散语言模型（Diffusion Large Language Model，dLLM）正在探索另一条技术路线。它不必严格按照从左到右的顺序生成文本，而是通过迭代去噪、并行更新多个 Tok
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DiffuSpace 开源 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview，35B 总参、3B 激活的 MoE 达 680 tokens/s，空管 Demo 用 7.32 秒，Qwen3.5 为 62.3 秒。

en.title: No More Token-by-Token Generation: Diffusion Models Reach 35B, Set Their Sights on Agent Coding
en.summary:
Diffusion Intelligence open-sources Clover, rearchitecting its underlying network architecture

Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break past the serial constraints of autoregression through iterative denoising and parallel Token updates. Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is the first to bring MoE architecture to a large-scale dLLM, with 35B total parameters and 3B activated.

dLLMs decouple generation order, enabling higher parallelism; Clover-35B uses MoE to balance parameter scale against inference efficiency; the open-source preview offers the first empirical baseline for testing the capability boundaries of dLLMs at large-model scale.

Written for NLP algorithm engineers, LLM inference optimization engineers, and AI architects.

Must large language models always generate Tokens one by one, left to right? For years, autoregressive models such as GPT, Claude, and Qwen have dominated. As model capabilities improve, the serial compute overhead of Token-by-Token decoding has become a major factor limiting inference speed. Diffusion language models are exploring another route: instead of strictly generating text left to right, they iteratively denoise and update multiple Tokens in parallel.
en.reason: DiffuSpace has open-sourced Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a 35B-total, 3B-active MoE diffusion language model that reaches 680 tokens/s and completes an air-traffic-control demo in 7.32 seconds versus Qwen3.5’s 62.3 seconds.

en.title: No More Token-by-Token Generation: Diffusion Models Reach 35B, Set Their Sights on Agent Coding
en.summary:
Diffusion Intelligence open-sources Clover, rearchitecting its underlying network architecture

Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break past the serial constraints of autoregression through iterative denoising and parallel Token updates. Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is the first to bring MoE architecture to a large-scale dLLM, with 35B total parameters and 3B activated.

dLLMs decouple generation order, enabling higher parallelism; Clover-35B uses MoE to balance parameter scale against inference efficiency; the open-source preview offers the first empirical baseline for testing the capability boundaries of dLLMs at large-model scale.

Written for NLP algorithm engineers, LLM inference optimization engineers, and AI architects.

Must large language models always generate Tokens one by one, left to right? For years, autoregressive models such as GPT, Claude, and Qwen have dominated. As model capabilities improve, the serial compute overhead of Token-by-Token decoding has become a major factor limiting inference speed. Diffusion language models are exploring another route: instead of strictly generating text left to right, they iteratively denoise and update multiple Tokens in parallel.
en.reason: DiffuSpace has open-sourced Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a 35B-total, 3B-active MoE diffusion language model that reaches 680 tokens/s and completes an air-traffic-control demo in 7.32 seconds versus Qwen3.5’s 62.3 seconds.

stories.title: 当AI智能体开始24小时炒币，真正赚钱的究竟是AI，还是交易所？ 我最近一直在思考一个问题。 假设未来有100万个AI智能体同时进入加密货币市场，会发生什么？ 它们不需要睡觉。 可以24小时监控比特币价格、研究订单簿、分析新闻、追踪链上资金流，甚至观察其他AI正在买入什么。 有的AI负责追涨。 有的负责套利。 有的专门预测短期价格变化。 还有的模仿那些看起来最成功的交易者。 听起来，整个市场都会变得异常聪明。 但我突然意识到一件事。…

en.title: When AI agents start trading crypto 24/7, who's really making money—the AI or the exchange?
en.summary:
When AI agents start trading crypto 24/7, who's really making money—the AI or the exchanges?

I've been thinking about a question lately.

Suppose a million AI agents enter the crypto market at the same time. What happens?

They don't need sleep. They can monitor Bitcoin prices around the clock, study order books, analyze news, track on-chain capital flows, and even watch what other AIs are buying.

Some chase rallies. Some arbitrage. Some specialize in predicting short-term price moves. Others mimic the traders who look most successful.

It sounds like the entire market would become extraordinarily smart.

But it suddenly occurred to me: whether or not these AIs end up making money, one type of company stands to earn from their trading activity.

Exchanges.

That's why I think the exchange is the most important thing for ordinary investors to study in the AI crypto trading boom...
en.reason: A hypothetical 1 million AI agents trading crypto 24/7 — monitoring Bitcoin prices, order books, news and on-chain flows as momentum chasers, arbitrageurs, short-term forecasters and copycats — raises the question of whether exchanges, not the AI, earn regardless of trading profits.

en.title: Don't take Artificial Analysis benchmark scores too seriously. Just look at its business model: Artificial Analysis mainly sells data services and custom evaluations to large model companies.
en.summary:
Artificial Analysis's benchmark scores are not worth taking too seriously

Just look at Artificial Analysis's business model and it becomes clear. Its main business is selling data services and custom evaluations to large model companies.

It bills itself as an independent third party, but as a vendor, if you want clients to pay, you have to sell them something. We can see what it sells from the founder's podcast.

The AA founder was asked directly on the podcast, "How do you make money?" The answer was candid — two legs:

① Enterprise benchmark subscriptions — selling standardized reports and model-selection consulting to enterprises and investment institutions;
② Custom/private evaluations — running private benchmarks, private testing frameworks, and dedicated workshops for companies, including AI model vendors.

Look...
en.reason: Artificial Analysis bills itself as an independent third party, yet its founder said on a podcast that it earns money two ways: enterprise benchmark subscriptions sold to companies and investors, and custom or private evaluations built for AI model vendors themselves.

stories.title: 世界模型，是 AI 的尽头吗？ Google 刚刚发布了新一代世界模型 Genie 4。它能够实时生成一个虚拟世界，你可以进入其中自由探索、改变环境，整个世界也会随着你的行为发生变化。 有网友开始畅想，未来是不是连《GTA》这样的开放世界游戏，都能直接用 AI 生成了？ 但也有人质疑，这些逼真的画面，究竟是在模拟真实的物理规律，还是一场视觉表演？ 我认为，世界模型可能是 AI 迈向下一阶段的重要技术，也有机会成为未来物理 AI 的基础…

en.title:
Douyin penalizes 507,000 accounts, calls out AI marketing accounts ⚠️

Douyin recently issued a governance notice aimed squarely at marketing accounts that use AI to mass-produce accounts, and one number stands out:

507,000 violating accounts penalized in the past month.

That's right — over the same period it also took down 1.135 million violating videos. Specifically called out: AI digital humans impersonating celebrities' relatives to sell products, AI mimicking celebrity voices to mass-produce quote videos, and mass copying of viral templates.
en.summary:
Douyin takes action against 507,000 accounts, calling out AI marketing accounts ⚠️

Douyin recently issued a governance notice specifically targeting marketing accounts that use AI to mass-create accounts. One figure stands out: in the past month, it handled 507,000 violating accounts.

In the same period, it also handled 1.135 million violating videos, naming cases involving AI digital humans impersonating celebrities’ relatives to sell products, AI cloning celebrity voices to mass-produce quotes, and mass copying of viral templates.

But that does not mean using AI to make content will get you penalized. The notice says at the outset that AI tools have lowered the barrier to creation; its target is malicious marketing accounts that seek only traffic monetization and treat AI as a shortcut to building accounts.

Notably, what is being called out is not using AI itself, but impersonating real people, fabricating fake footage, and mass-copying a single template. Using AI to help write scripts and edit videos is fine, but if an account’s content could be posted by anyone under a different name and still...
en.reason: Douyin’s latest governance notice reports 507,000 violating accounts and 1.135 million violating videos removed in about a month, naming AI digital personas impersonating celebrities’ relatives to sell goods, AI-cloned celebrity voices generating quote content, and bulk copying of viral templates, while stressing that AI-assisted writing or editing is not itself targeted—only malicious marketing accounts using AI as a shortcut to traffic monetization.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Macro 用 SolidJS 和 Rust 把 email、chat、docs、tasks、agents、calls、CRM 整合为带共享 AI 记忆和 @linked 双向图的统一工作空间，团队约15人已 dogfood 两年，试图解决曾扩张到约20人时靠 MCP 和 Zapier 拼工具的混乱。

en.reason: Macro, built with SolidJS and Rust, unifies email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM via shared AI memory and an @linked bidirectional graph; its 15-person team dogfooded it for two years to fix MCP-and-Zapier sprawl at about 20 people.

en.title: Anthropic platform engineering lead Katelyn Lesse: with thousands of AI agents working side by side, programmers are still needed to solve four hard problems. As AI gets better at writing code, many programmers are starting to wonder whether their craft is still worth anything.
en.reason: Anthropic platform engineering lead Katelyn Lesse, who runs a roughly 200-person team, argued in an October 25 post that supporting thousands of AI agents working together still requires programmers to solve four new problems before AI can accomplish big things.

stories.title: Google 昨晚发布 Genie 4，AI 开始从生成世界，走向模拟世界的运行规律！！！ 现在的 AI 已经很会生成图片、视频了。 但 Genie 4 更进一步，你可以直接走进 AI 生成的世界，改变天气、移动镜头、和角色互动，甚至听到实时生成的声音。 目前一次只能维持约 2 分钟的相对连贯交互，离真正的物理世界模拟还有很远。 但我更关注它未来的用途。 机器人可以先在虚拟世界里学习走路、抓取、避障，Agent 可以在模拟环境中反复试…

en.title: Google released Genie 4 last night, marking AI's shift from generating worlds to simulating the laws that govern them.
en.reason: Google's Genie 4 lets users step into generated worlds to change weather, move the camera, interact with characters and hear real-time audio, though coherent interaction lasts only about 2 minutes; the piece focuses on robots learning to walk, grasp and avoid obstacles in simulation.

items.recommend_reason_zh: Google 发布 Genie 4：用户可走进生成世界改变天气、移动镜头、与角色互动并听到实时声音，但仅维持约 2 分钟连贯交互；文章更关注机器人虚拟练习走路抓取避障、Agent 反复试错。

en.title: Google released Genie 4 last night, marking AI's shift from generating worlds to simulating the laws that govern them.
en.reason: Google's Genie 4 lets users step into generated worlds to change weather, move the camera, interact with characters and hear real-time audio, though coherent interaction lasts only about 2 minutes; the piece focuses on robots learning to walk, grasp and avoid obstacles in simulation.

stories.title: 昨天AI科技圈有点炸～～💥💥💥 一、Google DeepMind 推出 Genie 4：世界模型第一次"自带声音" DeepMind 在 10 月 27 日宣布 Genie 4，先以研究预览开放给受邀测试者。它不是生成一段固定视频，而是实时生成一个能走进去的模拟环境：你用键盘走动、用文字下指令，世界随之变化。 最大变化是声音——它是 DeepMind 第一个原生生成音频的实时世界模型，风声、海浪、音乐和角色对白都由模型同步生成，角色…

en.title:
The AI tech world had a bit of a moment yesterday 💥💥💥

1. Google DeepMind launches Genie 4: the first world model with its own sound
DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, initially opening it as a research preview to invited testers.
en.reason: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27 as a research preview for invited testers, a real-time world model that generates walkable simulated environments from keyboard and text input and is the first to natively generate synchronized audio—wind, waves, music and character dialogue—with scenes editable mid-run for about two minutes of coherence.

The AI tech world had a bit of a moment yesterday 💥💥💥

1. Google DeepMind launches Genie 4: the first world model with its own sound
DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, initially opening it as a research preview to invited testers.
en.reason: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27 as a research preview for invited testers, a real-time world model that generates walkable simulated environments from keyboard and text input and is the first to natively generate synchronized audio—wind, waves, music and character dialogue—with scenes editable mid-run for about two minutes of coherence.
